disclosed.source: the prose of the filing's main document, read by scripts/lib/bdc-prose.mjs; every figure carries its sentence

assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's asset coverage ratio was 206%.

floatingShare.sentence: As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, 91.7% and 91.6% of the loans in our portfolio bore interest at a floating rate, respectively.

portfolioCompanies.sentence: At June 30, 2026, the Company had investments in 116 portfolio companies.

nonAccrualCostPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had loans to five portfolio companies that were on non-accrual status, which represented approximately 8.5% of the Company's total investments at cost and 5.4% at fair value.

nonAccrualFvPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had loans to five portfolio companies that were on non-accrual status, which represented approximately 8.5% of the Company's total investments at cost and 5.4% at fair value.

internallyManaged.sentence: Stellus Capital Investment Corporation ("we", "us", "our" and the "Company") was formed as a Maryland corporation on May 18, 2012 ("Inception") and is an externally managed, closed-end, non-diversified investment management company.

sbaExempt.sentence: On August 12, 2014, the Company obtained exemptive relief from the SEC to permit it to exclude the debt of the SBIC subsidiaries guaranteed by the SBA from its asset coverage test under the 1940 Act.
